'''The Omniagent HTTP API''' is the core API served by the omniagent container on
<code>localhost:8080</code>. The consolidated <code>builtin_omniagent-api</code>
tool is ONE generic HTTP client against it, replacing the older
<code>kanban_*</code> and <code>cron_*</code> plugin tools.

== How to call the API ==

<code>builtin_omniagent-api</code> takes three top-level arguments:

* <code>method</code> (required): <code>GET</code>, <code>POST</code>,
  <code>PATCH</code> or <code>DELETE</code>;
* <code>path</code> (required): for example <code>/kanban/tasks</code>,
  <code>/schedule</code>, <code>/api/plugins</code>;
* <code>body</code> (optional): a JSON object for write methods.

The base URL is derived internally - never pass it in the prompt. A malformed
call returns the misleading <code>both 'method' and 'path' are required</code>,
which looks like a broken route, so '''after any write that is supposed to create
or change an entity, confirm it with a follow-up GET''' before reporting success.

{{OmniFact
|what=core HTTP API plus the generic builtin_omniagent-api client
|where=localhost:8080 inside the omniagent container
|status=in use
|source=Reference/Omniagent/Omniagent-API.md
}}

== Endpoint map ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Family !! Example routes
|-
| Kanban || <code>GET/POST /kanban/tasks</code>, <code>PATCH /kanban/tasks/{id}/status</code>, <code>GET /kanban/tasks/{id}/history</code>
|-
| Schedule and cron || <code>GET/POST /schedule</code>, <code>PATCH /schedule/{id}</code>, <code>POST /schedule/{id}/run</code>
|-
| Plugins || <code>GET /api/plugins</code>, <code>POST /api/plugins/{type}/{source}/{name}/enable</code>
|-
| Actions || <code>GET/POST /actions</code>, <code>POST /actions/{id}/run</code>
|-
| Hooks || <code>GET/POST /hooks</code>, <code>POST /hooks/{id}/fire</code>
|-
| Channels || <code>GET /channels</code>, <code>GET /platforms</code>
|-
| Settings || <code>GET /settings</code>, <code>PUT /settings</code>
|-
| MCP || <code>GET /mcp/tools</code>, <code>POST /mcp/execute</code>
|-
| Database (read-only) || <code>POST /db/query</code>, <code>GET /db/tables</code>, <code>GET /db/columns</code>
|}

Plugin endpoints carry the <code>/api</code> prefix; kanban, schedule, hooks,
actions, channels and settings do not.

== Examples ==

<pre>
# List the kanban board
builtin_omniagent-api(method="GET", path="/kanban/tasks")

# Create a task in todo
builtin_omniagent-api(method="POST", path="/kanban/tasks",
    body={"title":"Fix login bug","status":"todo","board":"default","profile":"omni"})

# Move a task to running
builtin_omniagent-api(method="PATCH", path="/kanban/tasks/123/status", body={"status":"running"})

# List plugins and enable one
builtin_omniagent-api(method="GET", path="/api/plugins")
builtin_omniagent-api(method="POST", path="/api/plugins/tools/bundled/fetch/enable")
</pre>

== Health and long-poll ==

* <code>GET /health</code> returns JSON:
  <code>{"status":"ok","version":"&lt;version&gt;","uptime":&lt;seconds&gt;}</code>.
  The version is the release single source of truth, baked at build time.
* <code>GET /kanban/tasks/{id}/wait?until=done,blocked&amp;timeout_s=900</code>
  and the matching thread route long-poll a status change. The
  <code>builtin_wait-for-status</code> tool wraps the same semantics; a timeout is
  a status, not an error.

== Tool resolution errors ==

<code>POST /mcp/execute</code> resolves the tool '''before''' executing and
answers a missing or blocked tool with a real status and an
<code>error_code</code>, <code>remediation</code> and <code>suggestions[]</code>.
The read-only database routes are owned by core and accept
<code>SELECT</code> or <code>WITH</code> only, in a read-only transaction with a
timeout and a row cap; a write attempt is rejected with
<code>400 db_query_rejected</code>.

A tool whose plugin is disabled answers with the plugin state rather than a
generic failure; see [[Plugin Tool Awareness]] for how to read that state. The
secrets routes used for <code>$secret:</code> references are listed in
[[Secrets Store]].
